mechanism: Successful two-hour mission following a positive PAYLOADING preparation; compare predefined UNLOADING during post-mission turnround with an equal-duration ordinary SERVICE control.

configuration.turnround: ordinary SERVICE ten-minute control versus predefined <UNLOADING> ten-minute child

hypotheses_to_test: Both variants perform PAYLOADING for positive ten-minute duration before the successful 8-10 mission.
After mission success, built-in UNLOADING is explicitly skipped or causes zero duration while ordinary SERVICE control performs positive ten-minute work.
The resulting readiness and report bins reconcile; every other business source field and mission outcome matches.
All populated source tables roundtrip exactly, conversion errors are zero, raw artifacts are sealed, and GUI/mutex guards hold.
limits: This is only the successful-mission branch of B05.var02; a failed-mission UNLOADING positive branch remains unverified.
Payload quantity and failure-state mechanics are not directly measured.
Other built-in subtasks, resources, GUI-only behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
